source: Agent 02 bundled approved v2 catalog; sanitized executable fields only; media omitted.

drills.name: Traffic-light accelerations

steps: Green = accelerate, yellow = controlled slow-down, red = stop in balance.

coachComments: You've got it when: No falls; reaches gate fast and controls stop.
Safety: Fun skill exposure; avoid fatigue races.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walk/jog cues over 3-5 m.
Harder: Randomize cue timing/direction or add ball.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Falling start

steps: Lean as one line until balance breaks, then punch first step and sprint through gate.

coachComments: You've got it when: Consistent fast first split without stumble.
Safety: Full recovery; stop if surface slips.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Wall lean to 2-step start.
Harder: Add visual cue or chase partner.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Wall switch to sprint

steps: Perform 3 crisp switches, step down under hips, then release into sprint.

coachComments: You've got it when: Stable trunk and quick transition to first steps.
Safety: Teaching drill; transfer must be checked in sprint.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: March holds only.
Harder: Partner releases or app cue.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Push-up start

howTo.setup: Athlete prone behind line; 10 m lane.
steps: On cue, rise efficiently and accelerate through 10 m.

coachComments: You've got it when: No extra setup steps; stable acceleration.
Safety: Keep volume low and quality high.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Half-kneeling start.
Harder: Race a partner or add randomized cue.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Light resisted acceleration

steps: Sprint against light-moderate resistance while preserving projection and step rhythm.

coachComments: You've got it when: Technique resembles unloaded acceleration; speed does not collapse.
Safety: Do not prescribe load from age alone; qualified supervision.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Partner towel/band with minimal resistance.
Harder: Individual load-velocity prescription under S&C oversight.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Build-and-fly sprint

howTo.setup: 15-30 m build + 10-20 m fly + long run-off.
steps: Smoothly build to fast relaxed running, hold through fly zone, then decelerate gradually.

coachComments: You've got it when: Fast fly split with stable posture and no reaching.
Safety: Require safe space, warm-up, and full recovery.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Shorter submaximal fly zone.
Harder: Longer fly or partner chase, not added fatigue.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Wicket rhythm runs

howTo.setup: 6-10 low wickets with individually scaled spacing.
steps: Run through at progressive speed without reaching or chopping.

coachComments: You've got it when: Clears wickets without heel reach or rhythm break.
Safety: Never force a universal stride length.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Flat cone marks with generous spacing.
Harder: Gradually adjust spacing/speed by athlete.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Chase sprint

howTo.setup: Two lanes, 5-20 m based on age.
steps: Leader starts by movement;
chaser reacts and tries to tag before finish.

coachComments: You've got it when: Competitive intent with no collisions.
Safety: Use lane separation and age-appropriate distance.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Side-by-side race on voice cue.
Harder: Vary start positions and distance.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Sprint-cut-sprint

howTo.setup: 8-12 m in, 45-90 degree cut, 5-10 m exit.
steps: Accelerate, brake before cone, cut, and reaccelerate through exit.

coachComments: You've got it when: Exit split improves without extra plant steps.
Safety: Standardize entry speed when coaching mechanics.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Jog entry and 45-degree angle.
Harder: Reactive exit cue or ball chase.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Repeated sprint quality set

steps: Run repeated sprints at high quality;
stop set when time or mechanics crosses threshold.

coachComments: You've got it when: Degradation stays within planned threshold.
Safety: Coordinate with match load; not for U6-U12 conditioning.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Fewer reps or 10-15 m.
Harder: Position-specific start and ball action.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Jump and stick

steps: Two-foot jump, land softly, hold 2-3 seconds before reset.

coachComments: You've got it when: Stable hold without step or trunk collapse.
Safety: Quality before height; not an injury diagnosis.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Submaximal ankle pop and stick.
Harder: Add lateral/forward direction or target height.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Snap-down to vertical jump

steps: Rise tall, snap to athletic position, pause, then jump and stick.

coachComments: You've got it when: Repeatable depth and stable landing.
Safety: Stop before landing quality falls.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Snap-down only.
Harder: Continuous snap-down-to-jump with no pause.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Countermovement jump cluster

steps: Perform maximal CMJ reps with reset between each.

coachComments: You've got it when: Height variation within set is small.
Safety: Do not turn power work into fatigue work.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Submaximal target jumps.
Harder: Add low external load only with qualified supervision.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Pogo series

steps: Small quick vertical hops from ankles with tall body and minimal ground time.

coachComments: You've got it when: Rhythm stays consistent; knees do not collapse.
Safety: Count contacts; regress for pain or poor control.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Two-foot low amplitude with pauses.
Harder: Forward or single-leg pogos for competent older players.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Low hurdle hops

steps: Hop over hurdles with controlled quick contacts;
stick final landing.

coachComments: You've got it when: No hurdle contacts and stable rhythm.
Safety: Low obstacles; never chase height at expense of control.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Line hops with reset.
Harder: Increase spacing or use mixed directions, not height first.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Single-leg jump and stick

steps: Jump vertically or slightly forward on one leg and hold landing.

coachComments: You've got it when: Both sides complete stable holds.
Safety: Asymmetry is a monitoring flag, not diagnosis.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Step-down to single-leg balance.
Harder: Add lateral direction or reactive cue.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Lateral bound to vertical jump

howTo.setup: Lateral landing zone plus vertical space.
steps: Bound sideways, stabilize briefly, then jump vertically and stick.

coachComments: You've got it when: Stable lateral landing and clean vertical takeoff.
Safety: Keep landing distance within control.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Lateral step-to-stick.
Harder: Remove pause or add visual cue.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Drop landing to jump

steps: Step off, absorb and either hold or rebound vertically on instruction.

coachComments: You've got it when: Stable alignment; no collapse; repeatable contact.
Safety: Advanced; qualified supervision; box height is not the goal.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Floor snap-down.
Harder: Slightly higher box only after objective competence.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: River jump

steps: Jump across, land and freeze;
earn points for controlled landing.

coachComments: You've got it when: Clears target and holds landing.
Safety: Gamify control, not maximum distance.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Smaller river/submaximal jump.
Harder: Choice of multiple distances.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Standing broad jump reps

howTo.setup: Start line and safe landing zone.
steps: Maximal or target-distance jump with controlled landing.

coachComments: You've got it when: Valid distance improves without backward step.
Safety: Full recovery for maximal reps.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Target-distance jump at 70-80%.
Harder: Broad jump to sprint.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Triple broad jump

steps: Three consecutive two-leg jumps with balanced final landing.

coachComments: You've got it when: Distance with consistent contacts and no stutter.
Safety: Stop if landing control deteriorates.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Two jumps with pause.
Harder: Bound-bound-sprint for older athletes.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Single-leg hop to stick

steps: Hop forward on same leg, land and hold 2 seconds.

coachComments: You've got it when: Stable valid reps both sides.
Safety: Pain or marked avoidance stops drill.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Short step-and-stick.
Harder: Repeated hop series after competence.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Lateral bound series

steps: Alternate side-to-side bounds;
hold final landing.

coachComments: You've got it when: Hits zones with stable contacts.
Safety: Progress distance before speed only if control remains.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Single lateral bound and stick.
Harder: Reactive direction or ball receive on landing.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Broad jump to 5 m sprint

howTo.setup: Start line, landing zone, 5 m sprint gate.
steps: Broad jump, stabilize briefly, then accelerate through gate.

coachComments: You've got it when: Fast transition with controlled landing.
Safety: Do not combine maximal jump and sprint under fatigue.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Jump, hold 2 s, then sprint.
Harder: Reduce pause or add ball chase.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Cone square movement game

steps: Move to called corner using run, shuffle or backpedal;
stop in balance.

coachComments: You've got it when: Correct corner and controlled stop.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walk patterns.
Harder: Add ball or partner mirror.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Deceleration gate

howTo.setup: Acceleration gate then 2-4 m stop zone.
steps: Accelerate in, reduce speed before zone, stop under control inside it.

coachComments: You've got it when: Stops in zone without extra steps or knee collapse.
Safety: Match entry speed when comparing technique.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Jog entry/wider zone.
Harder: Narrow zone or add exit direction.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: 45-degree cut progression

steps: Approach, brake before plant, redirect and accelerate through exit.

coachComments: You've got it when: Clean one-step redirect both sides.
Safety: Do not copy one ideal angle across entry speeds.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walk/jog entry.
Harder: Increase angle/speed or add ball.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: 90-degree cut progression

steps: Decelerate with penultimate steps, plant, and reaccelerate laterally.

coachComments: You've got it when: No false step; stable torso; fast exit.
Safety: Control speed before increasing intensity.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: 45-degree cut.
Harder: Reactive left/right cue.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: 5-0-5 technique reps

howTo.setup: 10 m build with 5 m timed zone and turn line.
steps: Practice each turning leg under standardized approach.

coachComments: You've got it when: Valid contacts and stable side difference.
Safety: Testing drill doubles as practice only in low volume.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Shorter approach at submax speed.
Harder: Randomize turn leg or add chase.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Mirror tag

steps: Leader moves laterally/diagonally;
mirror stays aligned;
short bouts.

coachComments: You've got it when: Mirror maintains distance without collision.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Slow lateral only.
Harder: Add gate escape or ball.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Color-call cut

steps: Cue appears after approach trigger;
athlete selects and exits.

coachComments: You've got it when: Correct decisions and improving movement time.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Cue before movement begins.
Harder: Later cue or ball action after exit.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Ball-release reaction

howTo.setup: Athlete central; partner releases/rolls to a gate.
steps: React to actual ball path, reach it and control/pass through gate.

coachComments: You've got it when: Correct intercept and controlled action.
Safety: Use predictable safe ball speeds for younger players.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Point/voice cue before ball.
Harder: Deceptive release or passive opponent.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Defend the gate

steps: Attacker tries to cross a gate;
defender reacts and blocks/tag-controls space.

coachComments: You've got it when: Competitive outcomes plus balanced movement.
Safety: Define contact rules and adequate space.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walking shadow without scoring.
Harder: Add ball or multiple gates.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Ball COD shuttle

steps: Dribble, turn with designated or free technique, and reaccelerate while retaining ball.

coachComments: You've got it when: Fast error-adjusted time with ball in control.
Safety: Score control errors, not time alone.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Wider turns and shorter distance.
Harder: Reactive route or passive defender.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Press-and-recover

howTo.setup: Press point 5-10 m out, recovery gate behind.
steps: Sprint to press cue, brake, then react to pass/escape and recover.

coachComments: Close fast, arrive under control, open and recover
You've got it when: Efficient transition without overrun.
Safety: Limit collisions; teach approach control.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Pre-planned press/recover path.
Harder: Add attacker decision and pass.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Small-space escape

howTo.setup: 4 x 4 to 6 x 6 m box with two exit gates.
steps: Attacker protects ball then escapes a gate;
defender applies realistic pressure.

coachComments: You've got it when: Retention plus successful exit rate.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Passive defender or larger space.
Harder: Smaller space/shorter decision window.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Free ball-exploration box

steps: Move freely and explore surfaces/turns;
coach/app occasionally calls a simple action.

coachComments: You've got it when: Continuous engagement and control.
Safety: No elimination games; keep every child active.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Larger area/no cue.
Harder: Add colors, traffic, or partner shadow.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Toe-tap and foundation rhythm

steps: Alternate toe taps and inside-inside touches in short quality bouts.

coachComments: You've got it when: Rhythm stays controlled without ball drift.
Safety: Warm-up/skill tool, not proof of match dribbling.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Slow alternating contacts.
Harder: Add travel, scan cue, or combination.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Inside-outside travel

steps: Travel using inside/outside contacts on one foot, then switch.

coachComments: You've got it when: Ball remains within playable radius at increasing speed.
Safety: Technique introduction before opposed transfer.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walk with inside only.
Harder: Alternate feet or add target gate.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Red-light green-light dribble

steps: Accelerate with ball on green, control speed on yellow, stop ball on red.

coachComments: You've got it when: Stops promptly without losing ball.
Safety: Space players to avoid collisions.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walking pace.
Harder: Add turn/weak-foot cue or opponent traffic.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Cone maze

howTo.setup: Random cone field, not one fixed line.
steps: Navigate freely, changing direction and surface while avoiding cones.

coachComments: You've got it when: Few collisions and purposeful turns.
Safety: Preserve choice; avoid long queues.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Fewer cones/larger space.
Harder: Color sequence, weak foot, or traffic.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Figure-8 dribble

howTo.setup: Cones 2-5 m apart based on level.
steps: Complete figure-8s with controlled inside/outside turns and both directions.

coachComments: You've got it when: More laps/touches with fewer errors.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Wider cone spacing and walk pace.
Harder: Narrow space, speed target, or scan cue.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Gates dribbling

steps: Score by dribbling through different gates;
no immediate repeats.

coachComments: You've got it when: High unique-gate count with control.
Safety: Keep all players active with adequate space.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Fewer/wider gates.
Harder: Color/number sequence or passive defenders.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Timed slalom with penalties

steps: Complete as fast as possible;
add time penalty for cone/ball-control errors.

coachComments: You've got it when: Error-adjusted time improves.
Safety: Do not reward reckless raw time.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Wider spacing/no timer.
Harder: Reactive final gate or moving finish.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Weak-foot gate circuit

steps: Use non-dominant foot for designated contacts, turns and final pass.

coachComments: You've got it when: Functional completion with reduced imbalance.
Safety: Exposure target, not punishment for dominance.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Alternate feet freely.
Harder: Add time, scan cue or passive defender.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Speed dribble with stop zone

howTo.setup: 15-30 m lane plus 3-5 m control zone.
steps: Drive ball at speed, enter zone and stop under control.

coachComments: You've got it when: Fast time plus controlled stop/no overshoot.
Safety: Long run-off and separated lanes.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Shorter lane/lower speed.
Harder: Add direction choice or pass after stop.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Color-scan dribble

steps: While dribbling, identify late color cue and exit through matching gate.

coachComments: You've got it when: Correct choices without control loss.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Early cue and wider gates.
Harder: Later cue, decoy cue, or passive opponent.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: 1v1 escape dribble

steps: Attacker starts with ball and scores by exiting a gate;
defender applies graded pressure.

coachComments: You've got it when: Escape success and retained control.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Passive defender/larger space.
Harder: Smaller space or transition finish.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Transition dribble to finish

howTo.setup: 10-20 m sprint/dribble lane into finish zone.
steps: Accelerate onto ball, carry at speed, then finish before line/within time.

coachComments: You've got it when: Fast action with controlled setup and target hit.
Safety: Manage shooting volume and retrieval lanes.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Shorter distance/unopposed walk-in.
Harder: Reactive target or recovering defender.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Pressure retention box

steps: Protect/retain for time or complete exit/pass after pressure cue.

coachComments: You've got it when: Retention time and successful exits/passes.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Passive defender/large box.
Harder: Second defender or smaller box.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Wall pass rhythm

steps: Pass and receive repeatedly;
alternate feet/one- or two-touch by level.

coachComments: You've got it when: Target hits and controllable returns.
Safety: Safe rebound surface and clear area.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Closer distance, trap then pass.
Harder: One-touch, scan cue, or moving feet.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Passing gates

howTo.setup: Pairs 4-15 m apart with target gate.
steps: Pass through gate;
adjust distance/width after success streaks.

coachComments: You've got it when: Hit rate improves at standardized distance.
Safety: Prioritize accuracy before maximal ball speed.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Wider/closer gate.
Harder: Moving gate receiver or one-touch return.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Receive through exit gate

howTo.setup: Receiver central with left/right/forward exit gates.
steps: Check shoulder, receive pass and take first touch through called/open gate.

coachComments: You've got it when: First touch enters correct gate within playable radius.
Safety: Log feed side and speed.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Pre-call gate and slow feed.
Harder: Late cue, variable feed or passive pressure.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Triangle pass-and-move

steps: Pass, move to next cone, receive across body, continue.

coachComments: You've got it when: Flow without stopped feet or lost ball.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Larger triangle/two touches.
Harder: One touch, second ball, or defender.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Two-touch scan pass

steps: Scan cue before feed, first touch prepares, second touch passes to indicated target.

coachComments: You've got it when: Correct target within two touches.
Safety: App cue latency must be known.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Target called before feed.
Harder: Later cue, one touch, or passive defender.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Moving-target pass

steps: Pass into receiver's path at varied speed and angle.

coachComments: You've got it when: Receiver collects without breaking stride.
Safety: Standardize when used for testing.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walking target/wider channel.
Harder: Defender shadow or one-touch next action.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Rondo 3v1 / 4v1

steps: Maintain possession against defender;
constraints scaled to level.

coachComments: You've got it when: Pass streaks and low turnovers under pressure.
Safety: Rotate defender frequently; avoid punishment role.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Larger grid/passive defender.
Harder: Touch limit, smaller grid, transition on win.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Third-player combination

steps: Pass into wall player, set to third runner, then continue movement.

coachComments: You've got it when: Combination reaches target at match-like speed.
Safety: Transfer via representative game afterward.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Walk-through with fixed roles.
Harder: Add defender or choice of third player.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Long-pass target zones

howTo.setup: 15-35 m target boxes scaled to ability.
steps: Drive/loft pass into target zone with both feet as appropriate.

coachComments: You've got it when: Target-zone rate with repeatable trajectory.
Safety: Control total kicking load; no painful groin/hip range.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Shorter distance/larger zone.
Harder: Moving target or pressured approach.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Pressure receive-and-release

howTo.setup: Receiver between passer and passive/live defender.
steps: Check away, receive with pressure, and release pass/escape through safe option.

coachComments: You've got it when: Retains and completes next action quickly.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Passive defender/known side.
Harder: Live choice and tighter space.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Knock-down targets

howTo.setup: Short distance with several safe targets.
steps: Strike to knock down/score targets;
reset quickly without lines.

coachComments: You've got it when: Target-hit rate with both feet exposed.
Safety: Accuracy before power; safe background.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Closer/larger target and stationary ball.
Harder: Smaller/choice target or rolling ball.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Gate shooting

howTo.setup: Multiple gate widths/locations in goal or wall.
steps: Score by striking through called or chosen gate.

coachComments: You've got it when: Hit rate at fixed distance/width.
Safety: Use enough trials; one shot is noisy.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Wider/closer gate.
Harder: Late target cue or moving ball.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: One-step laces strike

howTo.setup: Ball stationary, one approach step, safe target.
steps: Rehearse firm ankle and clean instep contact at submax-to-high intent.

coachComments: You've got it when: Clean contact and stable ball-speed trend.
Safety: Limit volume if hip/groin soreness.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Inside-foot pass strike.
Harder: Longer run-up or target requirement.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Four-corner accuracy grid

steps: Shoot sets at specified then self-selected zones;
score placement and miss.

coachComments: You've got it when: Zone score and dispersion improve.
Safety: Use repeated shots and report distribution.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Two large low zones.
Harder: Random late call or time limit.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Walk-in approach strike

steps: Walk then jog through a repeatable angled approach and strike.

coachComments: You've got it when: Repeatable plant/contact with target hit.
Safety: Do not force a universal plant location.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: One-step strike.
Harder: Faster approach or moving ball.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Dribble and finish

howTo.setup: 8-20 m dribble lane into shooting line.
steps: Dribble at controlled speed, use final setup touch, finish to target.

coachComments: You've got it when: Time-to-shot and accuracy improve without control errors.
Safety: Separate shooting lanes and retrieval.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Short/slower dribble.
Harder: Add COD, cue, or passive defender.
Lever: adjust volume, space, speed, cue uncertainty or opposition one lever at a time

drills.name: Sprint to finish

steps: Sprint, adjust steps, and finish moving ball within target area.

coachComments: You've got it when: Maintains accuracy/speed at higher approach velocity.
Safety: Full recovery; avoid fatigue-driven mechanics.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Jog approach/slow feed.
Harder: Reactive target or recovering defender.
